_comment: Deliberate exceptions for scripts/check-docs-accuracy.mjs. Every entry needs a reason — an unexplained entry is how a checker stops catching things.

_reasons.schematic names: registerX/subscribeX/getX* and the Gadget* family are invented stand-ins in walkthroughs (registration-seams.md, state-and-stores.md, support-type-extension.md), not real symbols.
_reasons.external symbols: n_coords and n_indices are fields of the third-party LYS mesh format, cited by docs/dev/lys-mesh-extraction-spec.md. n_indices previously matched by coincidence inside pure_down_indices() in the retired dragonfruit-astar crate, which is why its removal exposed the gap; version_comparator is a tauri-plugin-updater API.
_reasons.deliberately removed: kerf_mm is named in organic-cut-surface-redesign.md precisely to record that it is gone. satisfiesMinAngleFromHorizontal was the flat angle test in the grid attach path and auto-supports.md names it to record that the length-aware allowance replaced it.
_reasons.aspirational: page-tsx-refactor-handoff.md is a refactor plan; its symbols name extractions not yet made. packageManager is a package.json key npm has not adopted here.
_reasons.generated at build time: the paths are produced by scripts/generate-plugin-registry.mjs (generatedBuiltinSimplePlugins.ts by scripts/generate-builtin-simple-plugins.mjs) and are gitignored (**/generated*), so they are absent from a clean checkout, which is what CI checks.
_reasons.proposed, not built: island_replay is the name ADR-0025 proposes for a capability not yet folded in; pushToast is named in notifications.md precisely to state that no such API exists. format_info() is the trait method docs/internal/cli/new-format-plan.md proposes as one of two options.
_reasons.removed with the V3 routing: SmartPlacementV2 is the multi-joint router that SmartPlacementV3 replaced; docs/adr/0028-potential-gradient-pathfinding.md names it because the ADR records the approach it chose and the engine it ran in, and an ADR is history rather than a description of the current code. applyTrunkReplacement is named by docs/internal/backlog.md in an unpublished finding about the trunk replacement flow, which was deleted with it.
_reasons.unpublished plans against older code: docs/internal/cli/gaps-plan.md and wont-do.md, and docs/internal/slicing-engine-v3.2-roadmap.md, are working plans written against the code of their day, kept as the record of what was planned and why. updateBranch, loadFromLychee, updateKickstand, setHoveredId, setHoveredCategory, transformAllKickstands and the rle_*_labels pair were removed or renamed since (kickstands joined the shared support state; islands::rle kept four operations), and z_aa_steps / z_anti_aliasing became the zaa_* fields. Rewriting the plans to today's names would misstate what they said. docs/reference/cli.md, which describes the current code, was corrected instead, so these entries must not be used to excuse a stale name there.
_reasons.upstream windowing APIs: PlatformWebview and cef_window_handle_t are tauri and CEF APIs; wl_surface and wl_subsurface are Wayland protocol objects; windowless_rendering_enabled and set_as_windowless belong to the cef crate. ADR-0005 and ADR-0040 cite them to explain why the Linux CEF build embeds through an X11 window id, so they name code we depend on but do not own.
_reasons.projectObject: three.js WebGLRenderer internals, cited as the per-object frame cost in docs/dev/backlog.md; external API, not ours
_reasons.setProgram: three.js WebGLRenderer internals, cited as the per-object frame cost in docs/dev/backlog.md; external API, not ours
_reasons.renderBufferDirect: three.js WebGLRenderer internal, cited as the per-object frame cost in docs/dev/backlog.md; external API, not ours
_reasons.drawElements: WebGL context method, cited as how draw calls were counted in docs/dev/performance-debugging.md; external API, not ours
_reasons.drawElementsInstanced: WebGL context method, cited as how draw calls were counted in docs/dev/performance-debugging.md; external API, not ours
_reasons.VOXL_V2_SEMANTIC_REVISION: The 2.2 modifier-chunk revision constant, renamed to VOXL_V3_SEMANTIC_REVISION (3.1) in ADR-0042's re-base. ADR-0042 names the old spelling because the record IS the rename.
_reasons.removed with VOXL V1: VoxlCompressedDocumentEnvelopeV1 / VoxlCompressionRef / VoxlDocumentCompressionEncoding / SerializeVoxlOptions / VoxlMeshEncoding, and the Rust CLI's load_voxl_v1_from_bytes: all deleted with VOXL V1 read support, and named by ADR-0043 because the record IS the removal. Reimplementing any of them should be a deliberate decision, not a re-import.

_comment_webkit_symbols: The eight WebKit/JavaScriptCore internals above (javascript_gc_object_count through operationMapHash) are cited by docs/dev/performance-debugging.md as they appear in `sample` output and WebKit's own logs. They belong to the platform, not to this codebase, and will never be found here.
_comment_anchor_constants: ANCHOR_MIN_* / ANCHOR_SHAFT_MULTIPLIER: removed constants, cited by name in support-registry-findings.md because the finding IS their removal. The values live on the anchor descriptor's autoPlacement and are pinned by __tests__/autoPlacementPolicy.test.ts.
_comment_removed_support_symbols: updateTrunk / kickstandBefore / kickstandAfter: removed during the registry refactor and cited by name in support-registry-findings.md because the finding IS their removal. updateTrunk became the shared update skeleton; the kickstand* fields left AutoSupportPlan when kickstands joined SupportState.
_comment_removed_pathfinders: gridAStar / fieldDeterministicSolver / potentialFieldSolver, and the PotentialFieldSolver.ts path: the trunk-routing engines replaced by SmartPlacementV3 (PlacementLogicV3/SmartPlacementV3.ts). ADR-0028 is the decision record for the A* replacement and necessarily names what it replaced; page-tsx-refactor-handoff.md names the two solvers whose pre-existing test failures it recorded. Both files are historical records, so they keep the names instead of being rewritten to pretend the removed code never existed.
_comment_removed_kind_table: SUPPORT_KINDS: the eight-entry per-panel table in Settings/supportKindState.ts, deleted when the sidebar's panel vocabulary was derived from the registry (Settings/sidebarPanels.ts). support-registry-findings.md cites it by name because the finding IS its removal, and its flags (hasContactCone/hasShaft/hasPlateRoot) are the drift the derived panels removed.
_comment_rtsp_recovery_protocol_names: TEARDOWN is the RTSP protocol method name; SO_LINGER, CAP_NET_RAW and TCP_INFO are socket API names, TCP_INFO being the Linux socket-diagnostics option with SIO_TCP_INFO as its Windows counterpart. All four are external to this repo, which drives ffmpeg rather than speaking RTSP itself and touches no raw sockets today. docs/internal/rtsp-session-recovery.md and docs/dev/rtsp-relay.md cite them while describing the printer-side failure mode and the proposed recovery design, so none of them will ever be found in the tree.
_comment_gpu_ray_query: EXPERIMENTAL_RAY_QUERY is wgpu's own feature-flag name, an external API rather than anything in this tree. docs/dev/backlog.md cites it while recording which backends expose hardware ray tracing on the machine the AO bake was measured on, where the name is the thing an implementer would grep for.
